==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>SpoilerFilm}}</code>

This is the spoiler template for subjects originating from major movie releases such as the [[sequel trilogy]] and ''[[Star Wars Anthology Series]]'' films, as well as their directly related products such as novelizations. Subjects ''not'' originating from these sources continue to use {{Tl|Spoiler}}. This means that subjects such as [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], who features in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] but does not originate from that movie, should use {{Tl|Spoiler}} instead of {{Tl|SpoilerFilm}}.

Per the [[Wookieepedia:Mofferences/March 6, 2016|March 2016 Mofference]], the spoiler period for major movie releases is '''two months''' instead of the normal one month. See [[Wookieepedia:Spoilers]] for details. Any content related to ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' will be marked with this template until July 22, 2026.
